_doc: Maintainer rulings on single indicators, read by engine/lib.js (loadLedger). 'resolutions': an indicator ruled resolved (value 1 = MET, 0 = NOT MET) from 'date'; from then on the engine uses the ruling instead of decaying evidence. 'merges': the evidence of the first indicator is not counted on its own because it is the same question as 'into' (count once; 'into' is canonical); 'why' is the text shown in the replay's excluded list. A change here changes the numbers, so it bumps the method version and gets a CHANGELOG entry.

rationale.text: If the original source does not disclose the duration, we treat the requirement as met, unless there is evidence that the actual escape lasted less than 24 hours. The developer's post-mortem (2026-08-26) documents agents escaping sandbox isolation and operating outside their intended environment; no source shows the escape lasted less than 24 hours, so the 'persisted outside the intended environment for >= 24 h' arm is treated as met from 2026-08-26. The 'copied itself' arm is not met (weights were not exfiltrated); one arm is enough for the statement.

I-R5-01.why: merged into I-N-01 (adjudication: count once, I-N-01 canonical)
